_doc: Window 3 run list (physics perf campaign, L4+L2 measured against the P0b bridge and Jolt).
Protocol = P0b's ruling (D:/wt/joltab/docs/MEASUREMENT-QUEUE.md section 10 RESULT block; ANALYSIS.md):
a cell's statistic is the MEDIAN over K=6 separate processes of the process's window mean;
resolution = process-to-process spread (min-max, IQR; the median's SE 1.2533*SD/sqrt(K) supplementary);
a comparison is claimed only if |effect| > 2*hypot(spread_A, spread_B); a 5-s load receipt before and
after each process (> 5 % busy => re-run that process once at the end of its pass); a 10-s receipt
before each pass; no band-based void; placement P-none (no affinity call).
Two passes of 3 rounds; row order interleaved (Jolt and boyko alternating inside a W group) and
reversed between passes. One untimed warm-up process opens each pass.
Every exe below is verified against bin/SHA256SUMS before each pass. Nothing is compiled in the window.
boyko args are the driver's spelling (tools/driver.py boyko_args): the row args, then
Jolt args: the row args, then -t=W -i=500 (tools/driver.py jolt_args).

protocol.order: pass 0: W ascending, Jolt/boyko alternating inside a W group; pass 1: the whole list reversed

rows.what: the default configuration at aac562a7 = f236ebdd + C1 (L4: parallel_solve default on, lanes<2 inline) + C2 (L2: GRID_LO/GRID_HI 2,700/3,000). Printed knobs (logs/07): colored, simd_solve on, parallel_solve on, broadphase AllPairs under broadphase_select Manual, sleeping off, substeps 4, relax 2.

the P0b bridge: runner_tip (dbd85977) cfg-A = colored, simd_solve OFF, parallel_solve = (W>1), AllPairs/Manual. P0b's J-A-d1 cell, re-taken in this window so the bridge to the P0b table is same-window.
Jolt v5.3.0 Distribution, the repository's pyramid_scene.patch (banner 'boyko-parity-patch v1: damping 0 (Pyramid), no_pair_cache=0, allow_sleep=0, receipt=0').

conditional_rows.condition: C4 (L5, the parallel narrowphase) has landed on D:/wt/l5np: l5np HEAD != aac562a7 and its log names L5. At build time (2026-09-21 00:33) l5np HEAD == aac562a7, so this block is EMPTY.
conditional_rows.fill_in: The window stage builds the l5np HEAD runner into its own worktree + target dir (never D:/wt/l5np or joltab-msvc/vkval-msvc), copies it to bin/runner_l5.exe, appends its sha256 to bin/SHA256SUMS, re-reads the runner's usage text at THAT commit for the parallel-narrowphase flag's spelling (the '--parallel-np off' below is the task's spelling, not yet a runner flag), and asserts its 500-step --cfg default pose at W=1, 8, 16 equals 0x32d5e235342b4143 (L5 must be bit-identical) before any timed process.

extra_cells.note: flag spelling to be confirmed against the l5np HEAD runner's usage text

comparisons: D-L4L2 vs J-A at W=1 and W=8 (same window): the price of the default (simd_solve on, parallel_solve default) against the P0b bridge
J-A(this window) vs P0b J-A-d1 (19.671 / 9.162 ms): the bridge itself; if it moves beyond resolution, the window is not comparable to P0b's table
D-L4L2 vs JOLT-T and JOLT56-T at each W: boyko/Jolt like for like
D-L5 vs D-L4L2 at each W, if D-L5 is filled
